name: BanquetEventOrderBuilder
tagline: Banquet event orders from enquiry to a billed event – diary, capacity, deposits, final numbers and kitchen production in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete banqueting app for hotels, venues and caterers: function diary per room with clash and turnaround checks, capacity by setup style, deposit policy, final-numbers cut-off, BEO issue and versions, menus, dietary counts with allergen flags, run of show, kitchen production with overset, billing with service charge and tax, and the cancellation-fee schedule. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Enquiry → tentative → definite → BEO issued → final numbers → completed
Billing with service charge, tax and balance
Role rules for sales, coordinators and the director
Power Fx outputs and events (BeoText, ProductionJson)
